{{Quote|Captain Denner is stationed here in the outpost for the time being. He is organizing the transfer of Storm Squadron and salvage operatives to their new theater of operation. Jump to it soldier. Don't keep your commanding officer waiting.|Field Commander Alozen|<ref name="SWG:JtL" />}}
'''Denner''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] that lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SWG:JtL" />

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1.5 ABY]]<ref name="HolidayDate">{{SWBoards|url=thread.jspa?threadID=152583&start=870#15778940|thread=Holocron continuity database questions|user=[[Leland Chee|Tasty Taste]]|date=2006-10-12|time=6:13 PM}}</ref> he was stationed in the [[Imperial Fortress (Yavin 4)|Imperial Fortress]] on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]], where he was training [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] of [[Storm Squadron/Legends|Storm Squadron]].<ref name="SWG:JtL" />
